_description: 50 解剖实体 (2026-08-07 Grilling #25/26) | 58 皮层/皮下 + 11 脑干核团 = 69 functional_id | 67 功能剖面 + 2 mirror_of = 69 已剖绘

_coordinate_system.mni: MNI152 (mm, RAS+): X=右, Y=前, Z=上
_coordinate_system.game: 游戏世界空间: X=右, Y=上, Z=前

TransverseTemporal.std_name: Primary Auditory Cortex (A1, BA41, Heschl's Gyrus)
TransverseTemporal.notes: 听觉输入的第一站皮层. 音调/频率处理. 颞横回(Heschl回)

function_profile.primary_function: Primary auditory processing: frequency, pitch, sound localization
Salience detection and conflict monitoring; dorsal ACC (dACC/MCC) for error detection and cognitive control engagement
Rostral/pregenual ACC: emotion regulation and affective appraisal; top-down modulation of amygdala and autonomic responses
Dorsal ACC: cognitive control, effort-based decision making, pain processing; mid-cingulate for action-outcome monitoring
Broca's area (pars opercularis): language production — phonological encoding, syntactic processing, and speech motor planning
Medial OFC (DMN): self-referential value — personal preference, introspective valuation, and self-related reward processing

Precentral.notes: 运动输出的最终皮层端. 控制对侧身体运动. 皮质脊髓束起源

function_profile.primary_function: Voluntary motor command execution; final cortical output for skeletal movement
Emotional reward processing; limbic striatal gate for affective value → approach motivation
Motor interface for reward-driven action; translates limbic motivation to motor output via VP→MD→ACC
Lateral OFC: value-based decision making, reversal learning, and punishment prediction; updates stimulus-outcome associations

PeriaqueductalGray.notes: 防御行为选择(战/逃/冻). Hansen2024 GREEN社区核心. 柱状组织: dlPAG=主动防御, vlPAG=冻结

function_profile.primary_function: Defensive behavior coordination: freeze/flight/fight + descending pain modulation

Postcentral.notes: 触觉/本体感觉的初级皮层. 身体图式. 内感受的上游输入

function_profile.primary_function: Somatosensory processing: touch, proprioception, pain, temperature
Temporo-parietal junction (TPJ): theory of mind and attention reorienting — mental state attribution, perspective-taking, and ventral attention network hub for stimulus-driven reorienting

VentralTegmentalArea.notes: DA源头. Hansen2024 GREEN+BLUE社区. 动机突显(正/负)/目标导向. 投射至NAcc/PFC/杏仁核

function_profile.primary_function: Dopamine prediction error broadcast: reward/aversion signal to NAcc, Caudate, Putamen, PFC
Wernicke's area: language comprehension — phonological decoding, semantic access, and auditory-motor speech interface
Dorsolateral PFC: executive control hub — working memory maintenance, cognitive flexibility, planning, and top-down attention regulation. Cognitive CSTC loop cortical input
Medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC): social cognition and DMN — mentalizing, self-other distinction, person perception, and social value integration
Ventromedial PFC: value integration and emotion regulation — integrates reward value with affective context; top-down amygdala inhibition for fear extinction

SuperiorColliculus.notes: 视觉-运动接口, 威胁检测→启动PAG逃逸. 接收视网膜直接输入(Glu)

function_profile.primary_function: Superior colliculus: multimodal orienting — visual/auditory/tactile spatial map for saccade generation and attention orienting; subcortical visual pathway

Thalamus.notes: 感觉中继/皮层间通信/CSTC环路中继. MD核=前额叶中继, 前核=海马中继

function_profile.primary_function: Sensory-motor relay and CSTC loop closure; thalamocortical gating via VA/VL (motor) and MD (prefrontal). Closes all 3 CSTC loops
Visual attention routing; dynamically gates cortico-cortical visual information flow based on attentional demand

MedianRapheNucleus.notes: 5-HT. 投射至海马/隔区. Hansen2024 GREEN社区

function_profile.primary_function: Median raphe nucleus: serotonin (5-HT) source for hippocampus and septum — anxiety regulation, stress resilience, and theta rhythm modulation

DorsalRapheNucleus.notes: 5-HT源头. Hansen2024 PINK社区, 全脑关键hub. 感觉门控/冲动抑制/攻击调节

function_profile.primary_function: Dorsal raphe nucleus: serotonin (5-HT) source for forebrain — mood regulation, impulse control, and stress coping. Diffuse broadcast to cortex and limbic system
NAcc general reward-approach interface; integrates VTA DA, amygdala affect, and PFC goal signals
Entorhinal cortex: hippocampal gateway — grid cell spatial coding, sensory-mnemonic translation, and cortical-hippocampal information bridge
Anterior insula: interoceptive awareness and salience network hub; integrates visceral signals with emotional context for subjective feeling states
Frontal pole (BA10): cognitive branching — multi-tasking, subgoal monitoring, prospective memory, and exploratory decision making
Frontal pole (DMN): self-projection and mental time travel — future thinking, autobiographical planning, and introspective evaluation
Frontal pole (FPN): frontoparietal control — task set maintenance, cognitive flexibility, and adaptive goal-directed processing
Frontal pole (salience network): salience-driven cognitive engagement — detects behaviorally relevant stimuli and recruits cognitive control
Posterior cingulate cortex: DMN core hub for self-referential processing, autobiographical memory retrieval, and internal attention

Putamen.notes: 感觉运动环路的纹状体区(dlStr). 习惯形成/自动执行

function_profile.primary_function: Sensorimotor action selection and habit execution; somatic CSTC gate for motor programs

LateralOccipital.notes: 物体识别的关键区(LO). 腹侧视觉通路

function_profile.primary_function: Lateral occipital cortex: object shape processing (LOC), visual object recognition, and figure-ground segregation

CerebellumCortex.notes: 预测/时序/自动化. 内部模型. 技能熟练化→习惯形成的关键结构

function_profile.primary_function: Cerebellar cortex: internal model for motor learning and timing — predictive feedforward control, error correction, and procedural skill automation

Caudate.notes: 目标导向行为的纹状体区. 联合环路(dmStr)的皮层输入区

function_profile.primary_function: Cognitive action selection and goal-directed behavior; cognitive CSTC gate for prefrontal decisions

IsthmusCingulate.notes: 海马-默认网络接口. 空间记忆/场景构建. Alzheimer早期萎缩区

function_profile.primary_function: Retrosplenial cortex: spatial navigation, scene construction, and episodic memory retrieval; hub between hippocampus and default mode network

Paracentral.notes: 下肢运动/感觉代表区. 连接M1和S1的内侧延伸

function_profile.primary_function: Paracentral lobule: primary motor (leg/foot M1) and somatosensory (leg/foot S1) cortex for lower limb execution

Emotional salience detection and fear conditioning; subcortical shortcut (~50ms) + cortical route. Dual role: (a) limbic CSTC cortical_input (Amygdala→NAcc→Pallidum→Thalamus→Amygdala); (b) subcortical shortcut (Amygdala→PAG/LC/hypothalamus, ~50ms) as independent modulator bypassing CSTC
Primary visual processing: edge detection, orientation, spatial frequency
Occipito-parietal junction: visuospatial transformation — dorsal stream linking visual input to parietal spatial attention maps
Precuneus: DMN core — self-referential processing, visuospatial imagery, episodic memory retrieval, and consciousness; highest resting metabolic rate in cortex

Cuneus.notes: 背侧视觉通路的一部分. 空间视觉/运动检测

function_profile.primary_function: Cuneus: dorsal visual stream — visuospatial processing, motion detection, and visual attention allocation
Episodic memory consolidation and pattern completion; NMDA-dependent LTP for long-term storage
Pattern separation and rapid encoding; auto-associative network for novel context detection

Parahippocampal.notes: 空间导航/场景识别(PPA). 海马体的主要皮层输入. 内嗅皮层-海马的中继

function_profile.primary_function: Spatial/scene processing and memory encoding gateway; parahippocampal place area (PPA) for scene recognition
Automated habit execution and chunked action sequences; striosome/matrix compartment for skill automaticity

Fusiform.notes: 面孔识别(FFA)/物体精细分类. 视觉词形区(VWFA)也在附近

function_profile.primary_function: Fusiform gyrus: high-level visual object recognition — fusiform face area (FFA), visual word form area, and object category representation

Supramarginal.notes: 语音处理/工作记忆/模仿. TPJ的组成部分. 与角回一起构成感觉-语言界面

function_profile.primary_function: Supramarginal gyrus: phonological processing and somatosensory association — phonological loop, attention reorienting, and tactile-motor integration

PontineReticularNucleus.notes: Hansen2024 YELLOW社区. 脑桥网状结构, 运动/自主功能整合

function_profile.primary_function: Pontine reticular nucleus: brainstem arousal and REM sleep generator — reticular activating system component for consciousness and wakefulness
Ventral striatal reward-motor interface; incentive salience attribution

Lingual.notes: 腹侧视觉通路. 颜色/文字处理. 连接V1与纺锤体回

function_profile.primary_function: Lingual gyrus: ventral visual stream — visual word form area, color processing, and ventral occipital visual integration

Pallidum.notes: 基底节间接通路输出核. 抑制丘脑→抑制运动. CSTC环路关键节点

function_profile.primary_function: Basal ganglia output gate: tonic thalamic inhibition; striatal GABA disinhibits → GO release. Serves all 3 CSTC loops (cstc_loop=none, wildcard match)

LocusCoeruleus.notes: NE源头. Hansen2024 PINK社区, 全脑最强hub. 唤醒/警觉/应激. 双侧, 左(-8,-34,-22) 右(+8,-34,-22)

function_profile.primary_function: Norepinephrine-mediated global arousal and attention; diffuse NE broadcast to entire neocortex

LocusCoeruleusRight.notes: 蓝斑右侧对应. 与左侧共同构成双侧LC

function_profile.primary_function: Norepinephrine-mediated global arousal and attention; diffuse NE broadcast to entire neocortex
Angular gyrus: semantic processing, number cognition, and default mode network hub; cross-modal conceptual integration
Superior parietal lobule: dorsal attention network — spatial attention, visuomotor transformation, and reaching/grasping coordination
Inferior parietal lobule: multimodal sensory integration, spatial attention, and body schema; ventral attention network component

SuperiorFrontal.notes: 高级认知/自我意识/工作记忆. 包含SMA前区(pre-SMA)

function_profile.primary_function: Superior frontal gyrus: supplementary motor area (SMA) and pre-SMA — motor planning, action sequencing, and response inhibition

CaudalMiddleFrontal.notes: dlPFC后部. 工作记忆/执行控制的运动端

function_profile.primary_function: Caudal middle frontal gyrus: dorsal premotor cortex — motor planning, spatial working memory, and action sequence organization
Extreme frontal pole: highest-order abstraction — meta-cognition, counterfactual reasoning, and complex relational integration

SuperiorTemporal.notes: 含Wernicke区后部. 听觉联合皮层. 语言理解

function_profile.primary_function: Superior temporal gyrus: auditory association — spectrotemporal analysis, voice identity, and auditory object recognition
Superior temporal sulcus: social cognition hub — biological motion, face/voice integration, theory of mind, and social perception

BanksSTS.notes: 社会知觉/生物运动检测. 意图感知/心理理论的前体

function_profile.primary_function: Banks of superior temporal sulcus: social perception — biological motion, gaze direction, face/voice integration for social cognition
Inferior temporal cortex: ventral visual stream — complex object recognition, color perception, and visual memory

MiddleTemporal.notes: 运动处理(MT/MST). 语义记忆. 背侧听觉通路

function_profile.primary_function: Middle temporal gyrus: motion processing (MT/V5), semantic language, and multimodal association; dorsal visual stream motion hub
Temporal pole: semantic hub for person knowledge, social concepts, and cross-modal semantic integration; anterior temporal lobe semantic hub

SubstantiaNigraParsCompacta.notes: DA源头. Hansen2024 GREEN社区. 运动启动/奖励学习. 帕金森病关键结构

function_profile.primary_function: Nigrostriatal dopamine for action initiation, vigor, and habit reinforcement; D1/D2 modulation
Nigrostriatal dopamine for action initiation, vigor, and habit reinforcement; D1/D2 modulation

SubthalamicNucleus.notes: 底丘脑核 — 超直接通路 STOP 信号源 (Nambu 2015)。MNI 坐标来自 Paxinos & Mai (2004) Atlas。无 OBJ 文件（脑干核团点）。服务所有 3 条 CSTC 环路的全局急停。Grilling #26 (2026-08-07) 新增。

function_profile.primary_function: Hyperdirect emergency brake: cortex→STN→GPi fast excitation, globally suppresses all ongoing action
